target: an explicit flag carries the call past the gate (exit 2 = reached require_key, not 7 = refused)
cmd: cat "$FIXTURES/preflight/brief-large.json" | env -u MOCK_RESPONSE_FILE -u OPENAI_API_KEY -u OPENROUTER_API_KEY -u FABLE_KEY FACTORY_COST_THRESHOLD_USD=0.001 bash "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/call_sol.sh" --mode adversary --authorize-cost 2>err >/dev/null; echo "EXIT:$?"; cat err
_note: --authorize-cost is an UNKNOWN FLAG before this spec, which also exits 2. Requiring the line to say 'authorized' is what makes exit 2 mean 'passed the gate' rather than 'rejected the flag'. must_find is case-sensitive as of 2026-08-11; this needle now matches the literal casing the code emits.
